methods.name: split
methods.summary: Generate indices to split data into training and test set.

parameters.description: Number of folds. Must be at least 2.
parameters.name: n_splits

parameters.description:
Whether to shuffle each class's samples before splitting into batches.
Note that the samples within each split will not be shuffled.
This implementation can only shuffle groups that have approximately the
same `y` class distribution, no global shuffle will be performed.
parameters.name: shuffle

parameters.description:
When `shuffle` is True, `random_state` affects the ordering of the
indices, which controls the randomness of each fold for each class.
Otherwise, leave `random_state` as `None`.
Pass an int for reproducible output across multiple function calls.
See :term:`Glossary <random_state>`.
parameters.name: random_state

summary: Class-wise stratified K-Fold iterator variant with non-overlapping groups.
